_readme: Maps blog template sections to corpus files. One bundle = one chat.
Run order: A, B, C, D2 (any order) -> save each reviewed reply as drafts/<ID>.md -> D -> E -> F -> G.
A stage with a 'task' instead of 'sections' produces a working document (e.g. the events log) rather than template sections.
which: latest | prior | all | latest_n (with n) | since_latest_10k (10-Qs for periods after the latest 10-K)
items (10-K/10-Q): split-file labels. 10-Q: 1=financial statements, 2=MD&A, 3=market risk, 4=controls, 1-2=legal (Part II), 1A=risk factors, 2-2=equity sales/buybacks (Part II)
part (10-K/10-Q): cover = text before the first Item heading (share count lives here); full = whole filing

8-K: items_any keeps 8-Ks listing any of these items; items_other_than keeps 8-Ks listing at least one item NOT in the list; main / exhibits choose the 8-K body and/or its exhibit files; exhibits_skip_if_items drops exhibits from 8-Ks that list those items (earnings releases already sit in bundle B)
file: name = exact filename in the corpus folder (e.g. form4_summary.md)
when: no_10q_since_latest_10k | has_10q_since_latest_10k - include this source only in that situation

bundles.title: Business, competition, moat
bundles.notes: MD&A (Item 7) is included because some filers, APLD among them, point Item 1 to the MD&A 'Business Overview' for the business description. Section 7's competitor list comes from the company's own Item 1. Name it as the company's framing, not an independent view.

bundles.title: The numbers and the driver
bundles.notes: Section 3 asks for 'the ONE number flagged as thesis-critical last time'. That comes from your previous post, not the filings. Paste it into the chat, or the section will mark it as an open item. When the 10-K is the most recent period, its Item 8 is added so the balance sheet, debt and interest figures are present.

bundles.title: Forensic read: financial statements and notes
bundles.notes: If Item 8 is only a pointer to later pages, the notes live under Item 15; add "15" to the 10-K items above.

bundles.title: Material events log
bundles.task: Build a dated log of every material 8-K below: one row per filing with date | 8-K items | what happened (one plain sentence) | share or debt impact (instrument, amount, conversion or interest terms, as stated) | counterparty | citation. Then list separately: (a) every financing that adds debt or can add shares, (b) every related-party or insider-linked agreement, (c) every dated future obligation or milestone. Facts as stated only; no assessment.
bundles.notes: 8-K bodies only; exhibits are left out to fit the budget (Item 1.01 bodies carry the agreement terms). If a row needs an exhibit, note it as an open item and add that file by hand.

bundles.title: Forensic read: share structure, insiders, related parties
bundles.notes: Financing and dilution events come from the reviewed events log (drafts/D2.md). form4_signal_only.csv lists each open-market trade so the summary can be checked by name and date.

bundles.title: Valuation
bundles.notes: Works from the reviewed B/C/D drafts (reported figures, earnings adjustments, share count) plus your hand-entered market_data.md. Filings alone can't supply price, ranges, or consensus.

bundles.title: Bull/bear, patterns, precedents
bundles.notes: Section 11.2 precedents are not in the filings. Enable web search for this chat; any precedent without a live citation must be marked UNVERIFIED.

bundles.title: Assembly: header, setup, close, full post
bundles.notes: Stitches the reviewed drafts into one post in template order. Writes only the new sections; edits the drafts only for flow and consistency.
